cardOverview.overviewText: A Prime Advantage Mastercard variant delivering premium rewards, lifestyle privileges, and milestone perks.

items.child: Up to 35% off on Avis car rentals.

benefitRows.name: Avis
benefitRows.description: Up to 35% off on Avis car rentals.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, book car rentals on the Avis website or app using your credit card to get up to 35% discount. Contact SBI customer care at 1800 180 1290 for help.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: 4 complimentary rounds on Green fee and up to 50% off on golf games, along with 1 complimentary golf lesson per month at the selected golf courses across India.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.
